name: Lucivane
description: Lucivane is a precision-targeted acetylcholine modulator combined with a proprietary SNT-derived signaling peptide that maintains a thin layer of meta-awareness during REM sleep, granting users full lucid control of their dreamscapes without waking them. Unlike crude early-generation lucid dream compounds, Lucivane preserves dream stability and prevents the common 'lucidity cascade' that collapses the dream state. Extended users develop the ability to construct elaborate persistent dream environments across multiple sleep sessions.
effects: Reliable lucid dream onset within first REM cycle
Persistent dream architecture across multiple sessions
Ability to summon and direct dream figures
side_effects: Some users develop preference for dream life over waking
Rare: dream state becomes 'locked' requiring medical intervention to break
duration: Active during all REM phases of natural sleep
cultural_context: Lucivane is the cornerstone of the 'dreamlife' subculture — people who have effectively built second lives inside their sleeping hours. Some Tier 3 and 4 users spend their waking hours working minimum-engagement jobs just to fund the lifestyle that exists in their dreams. Dream communities have formed: people using Lucivane in coordinated sleep sessions, sharing dream architectures, even conducting business and relationships entirely within constructed dreamscapes.
story_hooks: A client hires the crew to retrieve someone from a Lucivane commune — a person who has stopped waking up voluntarily and is now being kept in a medically sustained sleep state by the commune's leadership.

Someone has been committing crimes in a shared Lucivane dreamspace — crimes with real psychological consequences for the victims. The question of whether dream-assault is prosecutable is about to become very relevant.
